entities.summary: Luis Domingo Jiménez Rodríguez is a Dominican Republic professional baseball third baseman who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, Milwaukee Brewers, and Boston Red Sox. He has also played in the KBO League for the LG Twins.
